name: SpinCycle-Bikes
description: Campus bike-sharing REST API with Node.js, Express 5, SQLite, parameterized queries, pagination, conflict checks, and 48 automated tests.
outcome: Owned server.js & routes.js (middleware, routing, 404 & centralized error handling).

name: LandslideGuard NER
description: Northeast India rainfall and slope-monitoring prototype built with React 19, Leaflet, FastAPI, Open-Meteo forecasts, and an optional local vision-model experiment.
outcome: Honest prototype scoping with fixed-fixture API tests and graceful offline fallback.

name: Developer Portfolio
description: Static developer portfolio with zero runtime dependencies, automated GitHub/LeetCode/GFG snapshot syncing, and GitHub Pages CI deployment.
outcome: Modularized UI with change-only snapshot sync to prevent empty commit churn.

name: SmartFinance
description: Personal finance tracker with Express, SQLite, Chart.js analytics, budget summaries, and optional AI insights using synthetic demo data.
outcome: Relational SQLite schema with indexed queries, budget tracking, and demo-mode isolation.

name: GoYatri
description: Multi-mode travel booking app (buses, trains, flights) with interactive seat selection, role-based views, and Firebase Auth/Firestore transactions.
outcome: Deployed on Vercel with Firestore security rules and transactional seat booking.

name: HR Policy RAG Assistant
description: Document-grounded HR policy Q&A chatbot built with Streamlit, LangChain, Hugging Face embeddings, FAISS vector search, and Groq LLM.
outcome: Deterministic PDF corpus loading with scope classification and source citations.

name: SVS Traders
description: Inventory, billing, and returns management app built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase.
outcome: Supports stock uploads, invoice generation, and returns workflows.

name: PN-Junction Simulator
description: Interactive PN-junction semiconductor physics simulator with Canvas plots for depletion width and bias response.
outcome: Educational quantitative simulation with unit-tested calculations.

name: ClamIQ
description: Lightweight interactive quiz app with scoring, instant feedback, and optional webcam interaction via face-api.js.
outcome: Live on GitHub Pages with clean standalone quiz flow.
